many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); P=pos(I)

            def cont(p,direction):

                i=p*step
                while True:

                    seen.add(i)
            ca=cont(a,-1) if n>0 else None

            for dr in (-1,+1):

                    rows.append(('R',name,rr,a,b,n,out,ca,cb,nb))
    for cc in range(W):
        rs=sorted({r for r in range(H) if I[r][cc]==2})
        for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
            n=b-a-1
            out=any(O[x][cc]==1 for x in range(a+1,b)) if n>0 else False

            rows.append(('C',name,cc,a,b,n,out,ca,cb,nb))

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def feats_all(name,I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]);P={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2}
    rows=[]
    for rr in range(H):
        cs=sorted({c for c in range(W) if (rr,c) in P})
        for i,a in enumerate(cs[:-1]):
            b=cs[i+1]; n=b-a-1
            fll=all(O[rr][x]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            extA=len(set(p[0] for p in P if p[1]==a))-1>0 if any(p[1]==a and p[0]!=rr for p in P) else False
            extB=any(p[1]==b and p[0]!=rr for p in P)
            restL=sum(1 for c in range(0,a) if (rr,c) in P)
            restR=sum(1 for c in range(b+1,W) if (rr,c) in P)
            # nearest other dot sharing the endpoint's column, distance up/down from the endpoint (for horiz gap)
            rows.append(('H',name,rr,a,b,n,fll,int(extA),int(extB),restL,restR))
    for cc in range(W):
        rs=sorted({r for r in range(H) if (r,cc) in P})
        for i,a in enumerate(rs[:-1]):
            b=rs[i+1]; n=b-a-1
            fll=all(O[x][cc]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            extA=any(p[0]==a and p[1]!=cc for p in P)
            extB=any(p[0]==b and p[1]!=cc for p in P)
            rows.append(('V',name,cc,a,b,n,fll,int(extA),int(extB),0,0))
    return rows

def feats_detailed(name,I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]);P={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2}
    row=[]
    for rr in range(H):
        cs=sorted({c for (r,c) in P if r==rr})
        for i,a in enumerate(cs[:-1]):
            b=cs[i+1]; n=b-a-1; fll=all(O[rr][x]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            restL=sum(1 for c in range(0,a) if (rr,c) in P)
            restR=sum(1 for c in range(b+1,W) if (rr,c) in P)
            # count dots in perpendicular directions near each endpoint (within distance <= max length)
            pA=[p[0]-rr for p in P if p[1]==a and p[0]!=rr]
            pB=[p[0]-rr for p in P if p[1]==b and p[0]!=rr]
            nearA=max([abs(x) for x in pA]+[99]) if pA else 99
            nearB=max([abs(x) for x in pB]+[99]) if pB else 99
            row.append((f'H{rr}',name,rr,a,b,n,fll,restL,restR,nearA,nearB))
    for cc in range(W):
        rs=sorted({r for (r,c) in P if c==cc})
        for i,a in enumerate(rs[:-1]):
            b=rs[i+1]; n=b-a-1; fll=all(O[x][cc]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            nearA=min([abs(r-rr) for r in rs if r!=a],default=99)
            nearB=min([abs(r-b) for r in rs if r!=b],default=99)
            row.append((f'V{cc}',name,cc,a,b,n,fll,nearA,nearB,0,0))
    return row

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
D=[(k,G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']) for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']]
rows=[]
for name,I,O in D:
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    P={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2}
    for rr in range(H):
        cs=sorted({c for (r,c) in P if r==rr})
        for i,a in enumerate(cs[:-1]):
            b=cs[i+1]; n=b-a-1; fll=all(O[rr][x]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            UA=sum(1 for (r_,c) in P if c==a and r_<rr)
            DA=sum(1 for (r_,c) in P if c==a and r_>rr)
            UB=sum(1 for (r_,c) in P if c==b and r_<rr)
            DB=sum(1 for (r_,c) in P if c==b and r_>rr)
            rows.append(('H',name,rr,a,b,n,fll,UA,DA,UB,DB,len([1 for (r,c) in P if r==rr])))
    for cc in range(W):
        rs=sorted({r for (r,c) in P if c==cc})
        for i,a in enumerate(rs[:-1]):
            b=rs[i+1]; n=b-a-1; fll=all(O[x][cc]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            LA=sum(1 for (r,c) in P if r==a and c<cc)
            RA=sum(1 for (r,c) in P if r==a and c>cc)
            LB=sum(1 for (r,c) in P if r==b and c<cc)
            RB=sum(1 for (r,c) in P if r==b and c>cc)
            rows.append(('V',name,cc,a,b,n,fll,LA,RA,LB,RB,len([1 for (r,c) in P if c==cc])))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['type','name','pos','a','b','n','filled','UA','DA','UB','DB','inline'])
print(df.to_string())

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# collect gaps with features
data=[]
for name,I,O in [('D1',G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']),('D2',G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']),('D3',G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output'])]:
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); P={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2}
    for rr in range(H):
        cs=sorted({c for (r,c) in P if r==rr})
        for i,a in enumerate(cs[:-1]):
            b=cs[i+1]; fll=all(O[rr][x]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            # perpendicular dot count: dots in the crossing column
            pc=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if c_==a)   # column of a
            qb=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if c_==b)
            ia=sum(1 for c in range(W) if (rr,c) in P and c!=a)
            ib=sum(1 for c in range(W) if (rr,c) in P and c!=b)
            da=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if c_==a and r_<rr); db_=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if c_==a and r_>rr)
            ea=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if c_==b and r_<rr); eb=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if c_==b and r_>rr)
            data.append((name,'H',rr,a,b,fll,[ia,ib],[pc,qb],[da,db_],[ea,eb]))
    for cc in range(W):
        rs=sorted({r for (r,c) in P if c==cc})
        for i,a in enumerate(rs[:-1]):
            b=rs[i+1]; fll=all(O[x][cc]==1 for x in range(a+1,b))
            la=sum(1 for c in range(W) if (a,c) in P and c!=cc)
            lb=sum(1 for c in range(W) if (b,c) in P and c!=cc)
            pa=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if r_==a); pb=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if r_==b)
            fa=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if r_<a and c==cc); fb_=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if r_>a and r_<b and c==cc)
            ga=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if r_>b and c==cc)
            ha=sum(1 for (r_,c_) in P if r_>a and r_<b and c==cc)
            data.append((name,'V',cc,a,b,fll,[la,lb],[pa,pb],[fa,fb_,ga,ha],[0,0]))
print(json.dumps(data))
